items.title: 1 killed and 2 hurt in small helicopter crash off Miami, officials say

items.title: Deputy dies and another not expected to survive after firefight with suspect at Washington home where 2 others were killed
items.brief: One of two sheriff’s deputies wounded in a firefight with a suspect in Washington state has died, and the other is not expected to survive, authorities said Wednesday.

items.title: Democratic wave prompts GOP anxiety over Samuel Alito and future of Supreme Court
items.brief: The Democratic rout in Tuesday’s midterm elections sparked an immediate sense of unease on the right about the future of the Supreme Court and a new round of Republican anxiety over decisions by Justices Samuel Alito…

items.title: Mississippi Senate race turns into a nail-biter
items.brief: An unpopular president , a charismatic Democratic candidate and an incumbent who has underperformed other Republicans in recent elections have turned a US Senate race in Mississippi into the nail-biter of the midterms.

items.title: Security guard stops gunman who drove into Tampa-area Citibank Center and opened fire, killing a woman
items.brief: A security guard stopped a gunman in an exchange of gunfire after the shooter crashed a car into an outdoor area at the Citibank Center complex outside of Tampa and fatally shot a woman, law enforcement said Wednesday.

items.title: Mamdani’s tax on high-end second homes survives legal challenge for now
items.brief: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani secured a significant win Wednesday after a panel of Brooklyn appellate judges ruled his administration can resume plans to collect a new tax on high-end second homes.

items.title: Vance tosses Trump under the bus in a bid to keep 2028 hope alive
items.brief: Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday surveyed the wreckage of the MAGA coalition and spilled his thoughts in an extraordinary social media post that launched the 2028 presidential campaign.

items.title: Melania Trump to bring Russian and Ukrainian representatives to White House this week
items.brief: First lady Melania Trump will bring representatives from Russia and Ukraine to the White House on Thursday, after announcing a ceasefire in the city of Oleshky last month.
